utility: Consolidated Edison Company of New York, Inc.
effective_end_reason: Exclusive research cutoff; not a claimed tariff expiration. No automatic future-rate projection.

proration.effective_or_seasonal_change: Rates prorated by service-day shares in the billing cycle; SC1 actual customer readings may override seasonal proration.
proration.termination_exception: A customer terminating service within 30 days after commencement is billed for 30 days.

standard.name: SC1 Rate I — Standard
standard.eligibility: Ordinary residential SC1 customers not billed under another rate.

tou.name: SC1 Rate III — Voluntary Time-of-Day
tou.eligibility: SC1 customer electing TOD on/after 2014-03-01, subject to meter and account restrictions.
restrictions: Leaving Rate III prevents reenrollment for 18 months.
Electing as full-service, or switching from retail-access to full-service while on Rate III, requires one year on full-service Rate III.

steady_use.name: SC1 Rate IV — Steady Use
steady_use.unsupported_reason: Rolling60-minute integration updated each15minutes and top-three-daily averaging are verified. Exact midnight daily attribution and peak-boundary endpoint conventions remain unverified; no demand-plan ranking is enabled.
steady_use.demand_rule: For each applicable period each day, highest integrated 60-minute demand ending in that day, entirely comprised of intervals ending in same period; billable demand average of three highest daily maxima in billing cycle.
steady_use.holiday_observance: Listed dates only; no substituted weekday specified.
steady_use.eligibility: Opt-in SC1; AMI and operational communications required.
restrictions: Leaving Rate IV prevents reenrollment for 18 months.
SmartCharge NY incentives unavailable after enrollment.

smart_energy.name: Rider Z Rate I — Smart Energy Plan
smart_energy.unsupported_reason: Quarter-hour-updated rolling60-minute demand is verified, but midnight daily attribution and peak-boundary endpoint conventions remain unverified; pilot variants cannot be assumed eligible.
smart_energy.eligibility: SC1 with AMI; customers not selected for pilot electing Rider Z assigned Rate I.
restrictions: Leaving Rider Z prevents reenrollment for 18 months.
Unsolicited opt-in customers do not receive pilot price guarantee.

supply_warning: Con Edison full-service supply varies with plan. Never reuse Standard supply for TOU or Steady Use without plan-specific verification. ESCO contractual pricing may remain unchanged; supplier identity does not change automatically.

closed_or_special_plans.name: SC1 Rate V
closed_or_special_plans.reason: Standby service subject to General Rule 20, not assumed eligible.
